structural_family.name: low-chromium ODS FeCrAl
structural_family.reference_candidate: 125YZ-like Fe-12Cr-5Al + Y2O3/ZrO2; direct static Pb-17Li compatibility evidence, but limited ductility
structural_family.development_candidate: 106ZY-like Fe-10Cr-6Al-0.3Zr + approximately 0.3Y2O3; improved ductility candidate requiring full qualification
structural_family.not_selected_for_direct_wetted_baseline: 14YWT-class ODS without Al, due to inferior static Pb-17Li compatibility in the cited screening studies

purpose: reduce electrical coupling and MHD pressure drop
screen Pb-17Li corrosion and mass transfer
